description: Declared mutants of the state machine (docs/architecture/target/v2/state-machine-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 7 judgement 2; ids sm-). A mutant is killed only when the named test case fails; a build failure does not count. The Fable/high adversarial check of this list is recorded in the dev_log.

mutants.what: The first apply does not run the root's enter. Only it catches the first apply's enter (later applies' enters are sm-enter-old-value's)
mutants.find:
if (auto ran = world.RunSchedule(EnterScheduleName(value)); !ran) return ran;
    Kernel::SystemResult result;
mutants.expect: TEST CASE:\s+behaviour: initial\ enter

mutants.what: The first apply runs the enter before setting the value: the enter reads 'not entered'. Only it catches the first apply's order
mutants.expect: TEST CASE:\s+behaviour: initial\ enter

mutants.what: The first apply goes on, in the same apply, to take and apply the requests made before it (the root read again after the first apply). Only it catches the first apply handling requests

    if (!Access<S>::Applied(root)) return FirstApply<S>(world, root);

if (!Access<S>::Applied(ReadMachine<S>(world))) { if (auto first = FirstApply<S>(world, ReadMachine<S>(world)); !first) return first; }
    const StateMachine<S> root = ReadMachine<S>(world);
mutants.expect: TEST CASE:\s+behaviour: a\ request\ made\ in\ game\ initialization\ waits
